_comment: Sample Deepgram Streaming v1 'Results' frames hand-constructed from the API docs at https://developers.deepgram.com/reference/listen-live (live transcription wire format). Each entry models one frame the server sends over the WS. The shape — including the `is_final` (interim-final flag within an utterance) vs `speech_final` (end-of-utterance) distinction — matches Deepgram's published schema. Used by parse_deepgram_event tests so the parser is verified against real-world frame shapes, not the parser's own hand-rolled mock.

frames._case: partial: interim transcript, can still change
interim final: Deepgram won't revise this segment, but the utterance continues
speech final: end-of-utterance — the dock should LOCK this line

alternatives.transcript: hello world how are you doing today

frames._case: metadata: non-results frame the parser must ignore
empty transcript: should be ignored (silent gap)
